summary: Read a row of non-negative integer heights. The upright at index i stands at horizontal coordinate i, with its top at the stated height and its foot on the horizontal axis. Pick any two different uprights. The area they enclose with the axis equals the gap between their indexes times the shorter height. Find the pair with the greatest area and write that area as an integer. The area is a non-negative integer, and 49 is one concrete value it can take.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
